mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150k for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction starts below 1.1 million units signals weakening housing demand, which reduces confidence in broader consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 1100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate indicate a contraction in manufacturing output and labor market stress, signaling an imminent economic slowdown that depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 100.0 and UNRATE > 5.5 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers expectations of future rate hikes, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.25 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 440k million dollars, combined with rising housing starts, indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS > 440000.0 and HOUST > 1150.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS < 141000.0 and UNRATE > 5.6 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100.0, combined with a decline in real GDP growth, indicates a supply-side shock that disrupts production chains and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 100.0 and GDPC1 < 16200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
